Name: Fix Categories in Recipes
Author: Traktori
Description:
Fixes the cooking recipe tooltip that draws some ingredient categories as '???' and without an icon. Fixes the categories: vegetable (-75) and forage (-81). Also adds a new category to draw: fruit (-79). Forage uses the string Greens (Any) that was already in the game's files. It might be more clear to replace it with Forage (Any), but we'll see.

If you're using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830]Love of Cooking[/url] it already has a similar fix for this for its own cooking page and this mod's changes are ignored. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115]Better Crafting[/url] also changes the way the recipes are drawn and this mod's changes are ignored. So if you're using either of them this mod affects only the recipes drawn in the collections menu that neither of them touch.


[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
Hover over a food that uses vegetable (any) as an ingredient for example.


[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5 Windows and probably on mac and linux too.
[*]Should work in multiplayer.
[*]Should work with every mod since not many should touch that part of the code. But since it is a Harmony mod it might break in odd ways.
[/list]

[size=5]Known issues[/size]
[list]
[*]The translations of Fruit (Any) were done with google translate and as such will probably be incorrect. Post your correction suggestions if you spot any mistranslations.
[/list]
